entities.name: Terisia City
entities.description: The oldest and most advanced city-state on Terisiare, sacked during the Brothers' War.

entities.name: Third Path
entities.description: A newly formed arcane-studying organization seated in Terisia City.

entities.name: Ivory Tower
entities.description: An order of bookkeepers named after the city's towers.

entities.name: Archimandrite
entities.description: The leader of Terisia City and of the Third Path; their fate is unknown.

entities.name: Mishra
entities.description: Leader of the Fallaji who became inclined to raze Terisia City.

entities.name: Ashnod
entities.description: Banished from the Fallaji Empire by Mishra.

entities.name: Brotherhood of Gix
entities.description: A faction whispering to Mishra, whose members had been welcomed into the Third Path and betrayed the city.

entities.name: Hurkyl
entities.description: Third Path source of magical knowledge who died defending the city casting Hurkyl's Recall.

entities.name: Hajar
entities.description: Commander of the forces that sacked Terisia City.

entities.name: Fallaji Empire
entities.description: Mishra's empire that besieged Terisia City.

entities.name: Brothers' War
entities.description: The war during which Terisia City fell.

events.summary: Terisia City hosts the Union of the Third Path in 33 AR.
events.quote: In 33 AR , Terisia City was host to the Union of the Third Path

events.summary: After banishing Ashnod, Mishra, listening to the Brotherhood of Gix, becomes inclined to raze Terisia City.
events.quote: Mishra became inclined to raze Terisia City

events.summary: Terisian defenses hold the Fallaji at bay for months while civilians are evacuated through secret passages.
events.quote: The Terisian defenses were implacable and held the Fallaji at bay for months

events.summary: The Gixians betray the city and open the gates.
events.quote: They eventually betrayed the city and opened the gates to the onslaught.

events.summary: Hurkyl dies defending the city, casting a spell that makes three dragon engines vanish.
events.quote: Hurkyl died as one of the defenders

events.summary: Terisia City is sacked by forces under Hajar and burned; Feldon and Loran escape through tunnels.
events.quote: Terisia City was sacked by forces under the command of Hajar and burned to cinders.

events.summary: The ruined city is used as a military base and taken and retaken several times.
events.quote: This location was taken and retaken several times afterwards.

relations.note: Led the Third Path from the tallest ivory tower.
relations.quote: The Third Path was led from the tallest ivory tower by the Archimandrite
They eventually betrayed the city and opened the gates to the onslaught.

relations.note: Commanded the Fallaji forces that sacked the city.
relations.quote: sacked by forces under the command of Hajar
